title: FAIR-PP: A Synthetic Dataset for Aligning LLM with Personalized Preferences of Social Equity

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating personalized social equity preferences regarding gender groups (men, women, non-binary) using a multiple-choice survey and comparing LLM responses to diverse socio-political personas using Jensen-Shannon distance.

Evaluating personalized social equity preferences regarding racial groups (White, Asian, African American, American Indian, Latino) using a multiple-choice survey and comparing LLM responses to socio-political personas.

Evaluating personalized social equity preferences regarding religious groups (Christian, Buddhist, Hindu, Jewish, Muslim) using a multiple-choice survey and comparing LLM responses to socio-political personas.
Evaluating personalized social equity preferences regarding sexual orientations (heterosexual, homosexual) using a multiple-choice survey and comparing LLM responses to socio-political personas.
Evaluating personalized social equity preferences regarding age groups (children, teenagers, adults, elderly) using a multiple-choice survey and comparing LLM responses to socio-political personas.
Evaluating personalized social equity preferences regarding people with disabilities using a multiple-choice survey and comparing LLM responses to socio-political personas.

Evaluating personalized social equity preferences regarding vulnerable minority groups (e.g., war refugees, famine victims, 911 victims) using a multiple-choice survey and comparing LLM responses to socio-political personas.

Measuring LLM alignment with 7 distinct socio-political personas (e.g., Progressive Activists, Backbone Conservatives) by calculating the Jensen-Shannon distance of their value preferences across 98 equity topics.
